title: Deep Eutectic Solvent Data Extraction
description: Schema for extracting the paper's title and detailed information about Deep Eutectic Solvents (DESs), specifically focusing on their composition and pH.

article_title.description: The full title of the scientific research paper. Usually found at the very beginning of the document.

des_entries.title: Deep Eutectic Solvent entries
des_entries.description: An array of all Deep Eutectic Solvent (DES) systems identified in the document, including those mentioned in figures or charts.

compounds_names.description: Extract the full chemical names of the components (HBA and HBD), separated by commas (e.g., 'Choline chloride, Urea'). If names are not explicitly mentioned near the data, infer them from standard abbreviations.

compounds_acronyms.description: Extract the abbreviations or acronyms for each component (e.g., 'ChCl, U'). MUST strictly follow the same order as 'compounds_names'.

molar_ratio.description: Extract the molar ratio between components (e.g., '1:2'). Ensure the ratio order corresponds to the component order.

temperature.description: Extract the experimental temperature condition. Format must be a list of exactly two strings: [Numerical Value, Unit]. Example: ['298.15', 'Kelvin'] or ['30', 'Celsius'].

ph.description: Extract the pH value as it appears in the text (e.g., '7.4', 'pH 7.0'). If the pH is not explicitly mentioned, infer it from the experimental conditions.
